correctness.rationale: All cases proven by exhaustive classification of pairs of unordered vertex triples into same triple, one shared edge and disjoint edge-sets; binary law-of-total-covariance and an exact 3(n-3) incidence count yield the matrix. Six exact polynomial factorizations establish every sign and zero, including two internal simple roots. Python exhaustive graph enumeration for n=3..5 at seven rational p values verified all 16 entries per setting, 406 exact assertions; this finite check is corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural finite-sample classification of pairwise dependence among the four induced three-node network motifs; identifies four one-switch pairs, a pair with two separate sign reversals, and one universally repelling pair. The joint-sign pattern matters for motif-count uncertainty and is not just computation of a single arbitrary graph invariant. The double-threshold edge-density phenomenon is absent from the inspected estimation formulation.
